composition: Floodlit Roman amphitheatre on Piazza Bra at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is the center of Piazza Bra before dawn, looking straight at the floodlit Roman amphitheatre. The Arena's double ring of arches dominates the frame, its limestone glowing amber under the floodlights, with the broken crown of the outer wall silhouetted at the upper left. Café awnings and ornate street lamps line the left edge of the square, and the modelled 23 September 2026, 05:05 night scenario leaves the sky pitch black above the empty piazza.
